```luau
--!strict
-- FlareUpService: periodically ignites a random flammable part during an Active round.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Names = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Names"))

local INTERVAL = 8

local FlareUpService = {}
FlareUpService.Priority = 60
FlareUpService._services = nil :: any
FlareUpService._started = false

function FlareUpService.Init(self: any, services: any)
	self._services = services
end

local function getTelemetry(): any?
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
	if not mod then
		mod = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 5)
	end
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if ok then
			return result
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function FlareUpService._tick(self: any, rng: Random)
	local services = self._services
	if type(services) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	if workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.RoundState) ~= "Active" then
		return
	end
	local mapService = services.MapService
	local fireService = services.FireService
	if mapService == nil or fireService == nil then
		return
	end
	local id = workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.MissionId)
	local okPick, part = pcall(function()
		return mapService:RandomFlammable(id, rng)
	end)
	if not okPick or part == nil then
		return
	end
	local okIgnite, ignited = pcall(function()
		return fireService:Ignite(part, nil)
	end)
	if okIgnite and ignited == true then
		local telemetry = getTelemetry()
		if telemetry and type(telemetry.count) == "function" then
			telemetry.count("flareups", 1)
		end
	end
end

function FlareUpService.Start(self: any)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true
	local rng = Random.new(os.time())
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(INTERVAL)
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				self:_tick(rng)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[FlareUpService] tick error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
		end
	end)
end

function FlareUpService._selftest(self: any): (boolean, string)
	return true, "ok"
end

return FlareUpService

```

## Problem
Playtest critique:
- The report has no `flareups` counter, so no flare-up was ever confirmed in the 63 s playtest (about 7 ticks). Nothing says whether RoundState was never "Active", RandomFlammable returned nil, or Ignite returned false. `_tick` returns silently on all of these paths, and the pcall wrappers around RandomFlammable and Ignite swallow errors. A dead service looks the same as an idle one. (hint: Add rate-limited diagnostics in `_tick`. For example, `warn` once (guarded by a flag) when MapService or FireService is nil, when the RandomFlammable pcall fails or returns nil, and when the Ignite pcall errors. Print the error message in each case. Also log a `[FlareUpService] ignited <part:GetFullName()>` line on success so the Studio playtest console shows whether the loop ran.)
- A single Ignite call on one random part can return false (already burning, not flammable, or out of range). With an 8 s interval and one attempt per tick, a short round can produce zero counted flare-ups. This makes the acceptance criterion fragile. (hint: Within one tick, retry picking a part up to about 5 times until Ignite returns true, then count once and stop. Keep the 8 s interval between ticks.)
- `getTelemetry()` runs `require` and may block up to 5 s in `WaitForChild` on every successful ignition. If ForgeTelemetry is missing, that stalls the loop each time and returns nil silently. (hint: Resolve and cache the telemetry module once in `Start` (or lazily, storing it in `self._telemetry`). Reuse the cached module in `_tick`, and `warn` once if it cannot be loaded.)
- The loop is `while true` with no stop condition, and `Start` never stores the thread. This is minor, but the loop cannot be cancelled and keeps polling in the lobby. (hint: Store the `task.spawn` thread in `self._thread`. Skip the work cheaply when RoundState is not Active. This already happens, so just keep the check as the first line of `_tick`.)

```luau
--!strict
-- FlareUpService: periodically ignites a random flammable part during an Active round.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Names = require(ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared"):WaitForChild("Names"))

local INTERVAL = 8
local FIRST_DELAY = 2
local MAX_ATTEMPTS = 5

local FlareUpService = {}
FlareUpService.Priority = 60
FlareUpService._services = nil :: any
FlareUpService._started = false
FlareUpService._thread = nil :: thread?
FlareUpService._telemetry = nil :: any
FlareUpService._telemetryTried = false
FlareUpService._warned = {} :: { [string]: boolean }

function FlareUpService.Init(self: any, services: any)
	self._services = services
end

local function warnOnce(self: any, key: string, msg: string)
	if self._warned[key] then
		return
	end
	self._warned[key] = true
	warn("[FlareUpService] " .. msg)
end

local function loadTelemetry(self: any): any?
	if self._telemetry ~= nil then
		return self._telemetry
	end
	if self._telemetryTried then
		return nil
	end
	self._telemetryTried = true
	local mod = ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild("ForgeTelemetry")
	if not mod then
		mod = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("ForgeTelemetry", 5)
	end
	if mod and mod:IsA("ModuleScript") then
		local ok, result = pcall(require, mod)
		if ok then
			self._telemetry = result
			return result
		end
		warnOnce(self, "telemetryRequire", "ForgeTelemetry require failed: " .. tostring(result))
		return nil
	end
	warnOnce(self, "telemetryMissing", "ForgeTelemetry module not found")
	return nil
end

function FlareUpService._tick(self: any, rng: Random)
	if workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.RoundState) ~= "Active" then
		return
	end
	local services = self._services
	if type(services) ~= "table" then
		warnOnce(self, "noServices", "services table missing")
		return
	end
	local mapService = services.MapService
	local fireService = services.FireService
	if mapService == nil or fireService == nil then
		warnOnce(self, "noDeps", "MapService or FireService is nil")
		return
	end
	local id = workspace:GetAttribute(Names.Attr.MissionId)
	for attempt = 1, MAX_ATTEMPTS do
		local okPick, part = pcall(function()
			return mapService:RandomFlammable(id, rng)
		end)
		if not okPick then
			warnOnce(self, "pickErr", "RandomFlammable error: " .. tostring(part))
		elseif part == nil then
			warnOnce(self, "pickNil", "RandomFlammable returned nil (attempt " .. attempt .. ")")
		else
			local okIgnite, ignited = pcall(function()
				return fireService:Ignite(part, nil)
			end)
			if not okIgnite then
				warnOnce(self, "igniteErr", "Ignite error: " .. tostring(ignited))
			elseif ignited == true then
				local name = "?"
				if typeof(part) == "Instance" then
					name = part:GetFullName()
				end
				print("[FlareUpService] ignited " .. name)
				local telemetry = loadTelemetry(self)
				if telemetry and type(telemetry.count) == "function" then
					telemetry.count("flareups", 1)
				end
				return
			end
		end
	end
end

function FlareUpService.Start(self: any)
	if self._started then
		return
	end
	self._started = true
	local rng = Random.new(os.time())
	task.spawn(function()
		loadTelemetry(self)
	end)
	self._thread = task.spawn(function()
		task.wait(FIRST_DELAY)
		while true do
			local ok, err = pcall(function()
				self:_tick(rng)
			end)
			if not ok then
				warn("[FlareUpService] tick error: " .. tostring(err))
			end
			task.wait(INTERVAL)
		end
	end)
end

function FlareUpService._selftest(self: any): (boolean, string)
	return true, "ok"
end

return FlareUpService
```
